title: context-shunt v1.1 read-only tool arguments
description: The read-only tools an agent may call, validated identically by both cores so the two hosts cannot drift. context_shunt_import is registered only where a deployment configured the artifact_import boundary and the host capability probe supports it; it is validated here regardless so the contract does not depend on which modes a given deployment turned on. Paths appear here and nowhere else: they are authorized and discarded at capture time, and never enter request.schema.json, the envelope, the store or a metric label. Every disclosure is capped per page and charged against cumulative per-source and per-session budgets, so a large payload cannot be reassembled through these tools; a source small enough to fit those budgets can still be returned in full by the inspector.

readArgs.description: context_shunt_read. Exactly one source form: either paths (an initial capture) or handles (a refined question over snapshots the caller already holds). Supplying both, or neither, is rejected. A refined question re-uses the named immutable snapshot and never silently recaptures the source.

inspectArgs.description: context_shunt_inspect. Zero model calls. Addresses an existing handle plus the snapshot hash the caller believes it holds; a mismatch is refused rather than answered from a newer snapshot. Each result is capped at 16 KiB and every byte counts against the cumulative per-source and per-session disclosure ceilings.

inspectSelector.description: Strict union: exactly one of lines, bytes, search or aggregate. lines are 1-based inclusive ordinals; bytes are 0-based half-open offsets; search takes a literal needle, never a regular expression; aggregate performs bounded deterministic count, distinct and grouping over validated JSON.

oneOf.description: 1.3: bounded deterministic count/distinct/grouping over an array in a validated JSON snapshot. Optional expansion and embedded-JSON parsing cover Loki's minified result/values shape without regular expressions or unbounded parsing.

scalar.description: An exact aggregate comparison scalar. Numeric identities are excluded because a host JSON parser may already have rounded their lexemes; encode exact numbers as strings.

importArgs.description: context_shunt_import. Zero model calls. Adopts an oversized tool-result artifact an external producer already persisted, named by the path of that producer's manifest. The manifest and the artifact it points at are both untrusted: the path is authorized against the configured artifact_import roots, and every claim the manifest makes about size, digest, media type and content is re-proven against the bytes actually read before a handle exists. Returns a handle and bounded metadata, never the artifact's contents.

statsArgs.description: context_shunt_stats. Read-only. It cannot reset a counter, change retention, name another session, reveal content, or accept a caller-supplied label of any kind.
